kind_of_work: a collaborative dictionary; entry-centric etymologies in templates and prose, and set-centric Descendants sections
holder: Wiktionary's editors, per page revision; the views they attribute are held by the scholars named
licence_note: Wiktionary's text is dual-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; wety uses CC BY-SA 4.0.
notes: Language labels are Wiktionary's own codes, so no language map is needed.

Template:etymon's documentation gives "or" as the default conjunction of several etymons after one keyword, but glosses |:inh|etymon1|etymon2 as inherited "from both". In the core-2 sample only 3 of 5 such groups are alternatives: one is a suffixation written without :af (*věža), one gives two spellings of one word (once).
